messages:
Sam L: Quick poll — for the Usage panel token breakdown, are we leaning compact single-line rows (more items visible) or dense multi-line rows (more clarity per item)? org vs project scope needs to work for both.
Jordan M: leaning compact. most customers scan > edit. compact keeps the invoice list visible.
Meera R: I get compact but worried about discoverability of token denominations (prompt vs completion tokens) and the small print for discounts/credits. compact can hide that.
Taylor S: could we do compact by default with an expandable detail row? +1 for showing $ per token on hover/tooltips.
Emily C: accessibility note: hover-only info is bad for keyboard users. any extra info must be reachable via focus and have role="button" aria-expanded states.
DesignBot: Mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mock/usage-token-breakdown-v3 (v3 shows compact rows + chevron to expand to 2-line detail) :sparkles:
Sam L: looking at mock — proposal: left column scope switcher (Org / Project) stays fixed, token rows list in center, right column shows invoice CTA and cost summary. Thoughts on legend placement for sparkline? top vs inline?
Jordan M: prefer inline legend (right side of chart) so users don't have to scan back to top for which metric is which. keeps each row self-contained.
Meera R: inline legend increases visual weight. for mobile it collapses weirdly. maybe collapsible chart area that shows the legend below on narrow widths.
Taylor S: nit: token unit label should be consistent — use short suffixes: "tkn" vs full "tokens"? I vote full word for clarity; abbreviations confuse finance folks.
Emily C: agree full word. also ensure color contrast for the sparkline and legend markers meet AA. current brand blue on light-gray fails contrast at 12px.
Sam L: copy tweak — current CTA reads "Download invoice"; suggestions: "Download PDF invoice" or "Export invoice"? Which is clearer for multi-format future?
Jordan M: "Download PDF" explicit but locks expectation. recommend "Download invoice" + tiny chevron menu for other formats later.
Meera R: UX for org vs project defaults — product suggests sticking with last-used scope per user session rather than account-wide default. keeps context stable. any objections?
Taylor S: no objections. implementation note: preserve in localStorage then fall back to account preference endpoint.
Emily C: a11y checklist: ensure scope toggle is announced (aria-pressed or role="tab"), expand/collapse rows have aria-expanded, chart has descriptive aria-label and a text-summary for screen readers.
Sam L: action items: Meera to update mocks for compact+expand pattern and mobile legend (due Thu), Taylor to write quick accessibility spec and add code snippet for the toggle (due Wed), Jordan to validate copy options with finance and return with 1 recommendation (due Fri). I'll schedule a 30m sync if anyone wants to walk through the mock.
Meera R: will do — I'll add the cost-per-token microcopy inline and surface tooltip fallback for keyboard.
Jordan M: I'll ping finance and report back.
DesignBot: Reminder: design review 9/12 10am on calendar.
Sam L: thanks all :thumbsup:
